name: Provider Compatibility and Genuine Creative Scene Readiness
hypotheses: H1: V3-35 HTTP 404 is not causally attributable from public catalog metadata; do not assert a definitive provider root cause.
H2: a successful future live-structured scene must carry REAL model provenance rather than synthetic-host fixture provenance.
H3: no model-created video shall pass if the receipt, model SHA, scene hash, or actual MP4/AV evidence is missing or inconsistent.
allowed_current_actions: public unauthenticated metadata GET (no provider POST)
offline synthetic tests and actual Manim fixture reuse
forbidden_current_actions: new paid inference or model POST
alter frozen six unseen V3-33 denominator
possible_future_inference: A separate explicit user authorization and new preregistered experiment are required. V3-35 one-shot tag is consumed; no new GPT-6 Luna request under V3-36.

pass_policy.offline: All new and inherited adversarial tests pass on exact HEAD; no inference job executes.
pass_policy.genuine_scene: Requires a separately authorized future model-origin plan, claim-consistent semantics, isolated Manim render, decoded H264/AAC/SRT and matching hashes; presently NOT_TESTED.

source_grounding: Local exact Fraction arithmetic only; publisher-source and teaching-quality claims not proven
